outcome: immunohistochemical staining of cell cycle proteins (PCNA, Ki67, cyclin D3, p27, p57)
cohort: The study included women with term pregnancies, both diabetic and non-diabetic, who underwent cesarean deliveries.
finding: Compared to controls, diabetic placentas showed increased staining intensity of PCNA, Ki67 and cyclin D3 in the villous parts, suggesting alterations in proliferation and cell cycle arrest mechanisms.
